verdict.rationale: Anytype documents a local API and a dedicated API reference page (developers.anytype.io/docs/reference/) describing endpoints for objects, properties, types, and templates, and an OpenAPI spec is referenced as powering their MCP tools. However, no evidence confirms an interactive reference with runnable/try-it-out examples, and a direct probe for an openapi.json/swagger.json spec returned 404s, casting doubt on discoverability of a live interactive spec. missing for 10: explicit interactive 'try it out' console, confirmation of a publicly served OpenAPI/Swagger spec, independent user reports of using the API reference interactively.
